title: Traffic ban to continue in Munnar after another landslip on  Kochi–Dhanushkodi National Highway
description: Traffic was suspended on the  Adimaly–Munnar stretch of the Kochi–Dhanushkodi National Highway last Monday after a landslip occurred during highway-widening work. During the clearing works, another landslip hit the region, forcing authorities to extend the ban for another two weeks
